observations.says: it was handed in at Leeds at four: its sender was at the Leeds office then
Mrs. Holt was at the fête in Thornby from three until five, in the doctor's sight
Mr. Grove went to Leeds by the two o'clock train
the hand on the form is the clerk's: it tells nothing of the sender
read as Mr. Grove's, the telegram named the place and the hour of a meeting he meant to keep
read as Mrs. Holt's, the telegram named the place and the hour of a meeting she meant to keep
one key was drawn that evening, at half past nine: Mr. Grove's
